def snap(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    out = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] >= 8 and n['color'] in ('W','G','O','p','P','M','w'):
            rows=[q[0] for q in n['boundary']]; cols=[q[1] for q in n['boundary']]
            out.append((n['color'], n['pixels'], (min(rows)+max(rows))/2, (min(cols)+max(cols))/2))
    return sorted(out)

after = snap(current_frame)
print('before:', before)
print('after :', after)
print('changed:', {k:v for k,v in last_action_result.items() if k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done')})
</parameter>
</function>

def snap(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    out = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels'] >= 8 and n['color'] in ('W','G','O','p','P','M','w'):
            rows=[q[0] for q in n['boundary']]; cols=[q[1] for q in n['boundary']]
            out.append((n['color'], n['pixels'], (min(rows)+max(rows))/2, (min(cols)+max(cols))/2))
    return sorted(out)
